name: Winterlight - Where silence says it all
source:
As Elias returns to the coastal town that once sheltered him, he’s pulled into a slow winter of connection, memory and quiet decisions. Take the role of this young man and guide the choices he makes, surrounded by the warmth of townspeople young and old, often holding conversations in a bookstore over shared coffee.

[From [url=https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/winterlight-where-silence-says-it-all-switch/]Nintendo[/url]]
translation:
当埃利亚斯回到曾经庇护他的沿海小镇时，他陷入了一个充满联系、记忆和安静决定的缓慢冬天。扮演这个年轻人的角色，引导他做出的选择，周围有城里年轻人和老年人的温暖，他们经常在书店里喝着咖啡聊天。

[来自[url=https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/winterlight-where-silence-says-it-all-switch/]Nintendo[/url]]
